{{Quote|Once you're aboard the ''Aurora'', you'll need to blast her hyperdrive regulator in the engine room. That gizmo protects the ship from the powerful forces of hyperspace.|Crysta Markon|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''hyperdrive regulator''' was a device that kept the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] from overheating in a ship.
